answer: Last close leaves unused grader-seat stamps (dealt minus sealed). A first-seen answer counts only after it redeems one still-free stamp, burning R+1 units of last close's median grader payout, R being redemptions already taken this window. One willow of an honest head redeems the first leftover at 1 unit; the tenth clone must take a tenth stamp and burns 10, so the next head pays more. A copied sonnet cannot split a stamp, reset R, or mint old seats: the stamp list is last close's, and each stamp is a unique vertex the protocol retires on redeem.
